reasons.statement: POL-003 section 3.1 states that vendors on probation may receive orders up to ₹5,00,000 including GST per order.
CON-104 page 3 confirms that while on probation a single purchase order may not exceed INR 5,00,000 including GST.

sources.title: Vendor Management
sources.text:
- Approved: may receive orders of any value.
- Probation: may receive orders up to ₹5,00,000 including GST per order.
- Suspended: may not receive orders or be used as a quote.

Vendors not on the vendor list may not receive orders.

sources.title: Lotus Peak supply agreement
sources.text: While on probation, a single purchase order may not exceed INR 5,00,000 including GST. Orders may not be split to stay under this limit. Either party may end this agreement with 30 days' written notice. The Buyer may end it immediately if the Supplier is suspended under the Buyer's vendor policy. Signed for the Buyer by the Head of Procurement, and for the Supplier by its Director of Sales.
